sources_used.source: Cylex business directory - Monroe Township category pages and keyword searches (construction, cleaning, locksmith, auto, appliance, garage door, solar, oil, glass)
Google Maps local search in a real browser (HVAC, electrician, roofer, landscaper, plumber, auto repair)
NJ Business Directory - Monroe Township listings
Yellow Pages listings surfaced in search results (site blocks automated access)
Industry buyers' guide / trade directory pages surfaced in search

categories_thin: Towing: only Three Star Auto Service advertises towing inside the 10-mile band; Sullivan's Flatbed & Towing and Route 33 Tire sit at 952 Route 33 E, about 12.7 miles from Milltown, so they were excluded as outside the radius

Tree care: only two dedicated tree services were confirmed in-township; most Monroe 'tree service' results are landscapers that also do tree work, and several arborists serving Monroe are based in East Brunswick or Jamesburg

Insulation, waterproofing, chimney and window/door specialists: almost none publish a Monroe Township address; the ones in directories are based in neighbouring towns and only advertise Monroe as a service area
Moving and storage: four in-township movers found; self-storage is essentially national brands (Penske, U-Haul) which are excluded as chains
Locksmith and garage-door categories are polluted by apparent lead-generation listings sharing one phone number, so only a few could be treated as real independent businesses
caveats: Zone interpretation: only businesses with a Monroe Township, NJ address were counted. Jamesburg, Helmetta, Englishtown, Spotswood, Cranbury, East Brunswick and Manalapan businesses that appeared in Monroe searches were excluded even when within 10 miles of Milltown.

Distance filter: Cylex publishes coordinates for most listings, so entries around 10.1+ miles from central Milltown (Route 33 East, Bordentown Turnpike, Old Church Road, southern Dey Grove Road) were dropped, including Garden State Roofing, Flow-Rite Gutters, Jerry Noonan's Auto Center, Michael Smith Excavating, Brenner Drainage & Excavating, C H Excavating, White Brothers Masonry, All American Asphalt, Underground Only and Creative Closets.

A few entries are right at or slightly beyond 10 miles (SMC Fence 10.8, Comfort Oil 11.4, Family Overhead Doors 11.5); they are kept but flagged in notes because they are recognisably Monroe Township businesses.
Several Monroe contractors are home-based; the addresses shown are the ones the businesses publish, not home addresses gathered from any personal source.

Clusters of listings share phone numbers (609-619-03xx locksmiths and garage-door names; (732) 257-4590 for Apex Appliance and American Chimney; (732) 723-1212 for Muffler Auto Center and Royal Transmissions). These may be one operator under multiple names or call-centre lead generation - flagged in notes.
Entries marked 'one directory only (Cylex)' have not been independently confirmed; Cylex data can lag closures.
Most entries have no website recorded because no website was seen linked from a listing that could be opened; the triage team should look those up.
data_gaps: OpenStreetMap/Overpass API was unreachable from this environment (repeated timeouts on overpass-api.de and a mirror), so no OSM cross-check of trade businesses was possible.

Yellow Pages, BBB category pages, Angi, HomeAdvisor, BuildZoom, Manta, ChamberofCommerce.com, Porch, Find-open and BuildZoom all returned 403/Cloudflare blocks to direct fetching; Yellow Pages and BBB data here came from search-result snippets and one BBB profile page.

Google Maps and Google web search rate-limited this browser session (five-result limited list view, then a CAPTCHA), so each Maps category query returned only the top five businesses; map coverage is therefore top-of-category only.
No Monroe Township chamber of commerce or township-issued licensed-business roster was found; the township site's phone directory covers municipal departments only.
NJ Division of Consumer Affairs contractor licence lookup was not queried (no browsable town-level list), so licence status is unverified for every entry.

Websites and phone numbers are missing for a handful of entries (Summit Landscape, Next Level Air Duct, Air Management HVAC, Alen Security, RKD Tree Service address) because the listing card truncated or published no value.
